title: Enhancement: Track programmable components in PDDF
author: michaelc-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

In SONiC devices, many components may have upgradable firmware, beyond just the SONiC image itself. This could include items like CPLDs/FPGAs, TPMs, BIOS, etc... We can track these versions and upgrades through a new PddfComponent type. The components will be defined in the pddf-device.json with a method to read model, version, and revision, as well as update the firmware.

In https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22666 we add support for our Nexthop switch. This uses PddfComponent to track version and upgrade firmware on our programmables. See that PR for an example of the pddf-device.json the adds our devices.

### Current Behavior

No consistent behavior exists for PDDF based platforms in order to read model/version/revision or update firmware. 

### Proposed Behavior

Create a new PddfComponent class to manage and upgrade programmables.

#### Why I did it
In SONiC devices, many components may have upgradable firmware, beyond just the SONiC image itself. This could include items like CPLDs/FPGAs, TPMs, BIOS, etc... We can track these versions and upgrades through a new PddfComponent type. The components will be defined in the pddf-device.json with a method to read model, version, and revision, as well as update the firmware.

In #22666 we add support for our Nexthop switch. This uses PddfComponent to track version and upgrade firmware on our programmables. See that PR for an example of the `pddf-device.json` the adds our devices.

Fixes #22827

#### How I did it

Create a new PddfComponent class to manage and upgrade programmables.

#### How to verify it

Checking firmware version:
```
admin@dvc134:~$ sudo fwutil show status
Chassis    Module    Component        Version        Description
---------  --------  ---------------  -------------  ---------------
NH-4010    N/A       SWITCHCARD_FPGA  e8020216       Switchcard FPGA
                     CPUCARD_FPGA     e8010212       CPU card FPGA
                     BIOS             50.0022.06B    CPU card BIOS
                     ONIE             2024.08-dirty  ONIE
                     TPM              16.24          TPM
                     NVMe             A230W2EJ       NVMe storage
```
Check for updates:
```
sudo fwutil show updates -f ge_0x0217-komodo_0x0212-nh4010-firmware.tgz
Warning: fwupdate_fwimage_dir: /var/platform/fwpackage/fwpackage/.
Chassis    Module    Component        Firmware                      Version (Current/Available)    Status
---------  --------  ---------------  ----------------------------  -----------------------------  ------------------
NH-4010    N/A       SWITCHCARD_FPGA  golden_eagle_100t_0x0217.bit  e8020216 / e8020217            update is required
                     CPUCARD_FPGA     komodo_15t_0x0212.bit         e8010212 / e8010212            up-to-date
```
Do an update:
```admin@dvc134:~$ sudo fwutil update all fw -f ge_0x0217-komodo_0x0212-nh4010-firmware.tgz
Warning: fwupdate_fwimage_dir: /var/platform/fwpackage/fwpackage/.
Firmware auto-update for boot_type none is allowed
NH-4010/SWITCHCARD_FPGA firmware auto-update starting:
<SNIP>
NH-4010/SWITCHCARD_FPGA firmware auto-update status from e8020216  to  e8020217 : updated
Warning: All firmware auto-update has been performed.
All firmware auto-update has been performed
admin@dvc134:~$
```
